ruleset.name: OpenShelter PMD ruleset (W2-C gate)
ruleset.description:
The W2-C static-analysis gate (P2-16): all standard Java categories, reported at high-or-worse severity only (PMD priority 1-2; configured in pom.xml as minimumPriority=2 / failurePriority=2).
Two rules are lowered to priority 5 (never reported) because they conflict with this codebase's documented idioms, not because the code is wrong:
- FieldNamingConventions: every class carries the standard SLF4J `private static final Logger log` field; the rule reads `static final` as "constant" and demands UPPER_CASE. Excluding it keeps the idiom; a per-site exclusion would tax every new class.
- GuardLogStatement: demands if (log.isDebugEnabled()) around every logger call. This codebase uses parameterized SLF4J logging (log.info("... {}", x)), which evaluates nothing while disabled — the guard is dead weight here, and requiring it would force new code to diverge from every existing call site.
Pre-existing findings the code still carries (measured 2026-09-22 at branch feature/frontend HEAD) are excluded from the check via pmd-exclude-from-failure.properties — that properties file is the manifest of the excluded debt, so the gate fails on NEW violations without hiding anything.
